executions.name: Verify, merge, and compare exact evidence
executions.run:
set -euo pipefail
local_bundle="$RUNNER_TEMP/greenlit-ci-live-local/ci-live-local.tar"
github_bundle="$RUNNER_TEMP/greenlit-ci-live-github/ci-live-github.tar"
local_root="$RUNNER_TEMP/greenlit-ci-live-local-unpacked"
github_root="$RUNNER_TEMP/greenlit-ci-live-github-unpacked"
output="$RUNNER_TEMP/greenlit-live-parity"
chmod 0600 "$local_bundle" "$github_bundle"
/usr/bin/python3 -E -s -B \
  tools/release_check_credential_bundle.py unpack-local \
  --bundle "$local_bundle" \
  --output-root "$local_root" \
  --expected-sha256 "${{ needs.live_parity_local.outputs.local_sha256 }}" \
  --expected-source "$GITHUB_SHA"
/usr/bin/python3 -E -s -B \
  tools/release_check_credential_bundle.py unpack-github \
  --bundle "$github_bundle" \
  --output-root "$github_root" \
  --expected-sha256 "${{ needs.live_parity_github.outputs.github_sha256 }}" \
  --expected-source "$GITHUB_SHA"
mv "$local_root/parity" "$output"
mv "$github_root/parity/seed-github-actions.json" "$output/"
mv \
  "$github_root/parity/captures/shell-only-seed-github-actions.json" \
  "$output/captures/"
tools/check-live-parity compare \
  --repository-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" \
  --greenlit-binary "$local_root/binary/litci" \
  --output-root "$output"

prerequisites.name: Prepare credential-only boundary
prerequisites.run:
! /usr/bin/git config --local --get-regexp \
  '^(http\..*\.extraheader|credential(\..*)?\.helper)$' \
  >/dev/null 2>&1
git switch -C greenlit-live-github "$GITHUB_SHA"
command -v /usr/bin/python3 >/dev/null
command -v /usr/local/bin/gh >/dev/null
output="$RUNNER_TEMP/greenlit-live-github"
test ! -e "$output"
install -d -m 000700 "$output"
/usr/bin/python3 -E -s -B \
  tools/release_check_credential.py --self-test

executions.name: Clean, hermetic, and native performance policy
Run and verify repository gates under release litci twice
Recompare and seal exact candidate immediately before upload
executions.run:
set -euo pipefail
candidate="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/release-candidate"
parity="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/parity-evidence"
bundle="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/greenlit-release-candidate.tar"
tools/compare-parity \
  --repository-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" \
  --repository-id KanterLabs/greenlit-app \
  --source-commit "$GITHUB_SHA" \
  --greenlit-binary "$candidate/target/release/litci" \
  --capture-root "$parity" \
  --exceptions "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/docs/PARITY-EXCEPTIONS.md" \
  "$parity/seed-oracle.json" \
  "$parity/seed-github-actions.json" \
  "$parity/seed-greenlit-release.json"
tools/release-provenance verify \
  --repository-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" \
  --candidate-root "$candidate" \
  --parity-root "$parity" \
  --expected-source "$GITHUB_SHA"
digest="$(
  tools/release-provenance seal \
    --repository-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" \
    --candidate-root "$candidate" \
    --parity-root "$parity" \
    --output "$bundle" \
    --expected-source "$GITHUB_SHA"
)"
[[ "$digest" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]
printf 'sha256=%s\n' "$digest" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
